The Japanese Red Cross Society Saitama Prefecture Hanno District is accepting domestic disaster relief donations and international humanitarian aid donations.

【Domestic Disaster Relief Donations】
• 2024 Noto Peninsula Earthquake Relief (Ishikawa, Toyama, Niigata prefectures) / Acceptance ends March 22, 2027
• 2024 September Noto Peninsula Heavy Rain Relief (Ishikawa) / Acceptance ends March 22, 2027
• 2026 Otsuchi Town Forest Fire Relief (Iwate) / Acceptance ends August 24, 2026
• 2026 Kumamoto Earthquake Relief (Kumamoto) / Acceptance ends October 23, 2026

【International Humanitarian Aid Donations】
• Middle East Humanitarian Crisis Relief / Acceptance ends March 23, 2027
• Bangladesh Southern Region Refugee Relief / Acceptance ends March 23, 2027
• Ukraine Humanitarian Crisis Relief / Acceptance ends March 23, 2027
• 2026 Venezuela Earthquake Relief / Acceptance ends September 21, 2026
• Undesignated International Relief / Accepted year-round

【Donation Locations】
Hanno City Hall main building front entrance information desk (donation box) or Community Welfare Division (1st floor, Window 11)

【Acceptance Hours】
Weekdays 9:00 AM – 4:30 PM

All donations collected are sent in full to the disaster relief fund distribution committees of the affected prefectures. If you need a receipt, the Community Welfare Division can provide one.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/chiikifukushika/12265.html
